# Vendored Datastar runtime

`datastar.js` is the unmodified Datastar v1.0.2 bundle (MIT licensed, © Star Federation) from
<https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/starfederation/datastar@v1.0.2/bundles/datastar.js>, with only the
trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment removed. The browser tests import it locally so they run
offline against a pinned runtime.

To upgrade, replace the file with the new release bundle and update the version here.
